name: Femboys in my Head
source: After your father's death, you move into an old house hoping for a fresh start. Soon, cute femboys start appearing around you. For some reason, only you can see them, yet they feel as real as anyone. As you get to know them, you realize they might be exactly what you need. How will you navigate these relationships that exist only in your mind?
translation: 你父亲去世后，你搬进了一所老房子，希望有一个新的开始。很快，可爱的女同性恋开始出现在你的周围。由于某种原因，只有你才能看到它们，但它们却和任何人一样真实。当你逐渐了解它们时，你会意识到它们可能正是你所需要的。你将如何驾驭这些只存在于你脑海中的关系？
